settings.name: CACHE_PATH
settings.description: Path and parameters for a cache.

settings.name: CACHE_ZONE
settings.description: Name of cache zone to use (specified in a CACHE_PATH setting).

settings.name: CACHE_BACKGROUND_UPDATE
settings.description: Enable or disable background update of the cache.

settings.name: CACHE_BYPASS
settings.description: List of variables to determine if the cache should be bypassed or not.

settings.name: CACHE_NO_CACHE
settings.description: Disable caching if variables are set.

settings.name: CACHE_KEY
settings.description: Key used to identify cached elements.

settings.name: CACHE_CONVERT_HEAD_TO_GET
settings.description: Convert HEAD requests to GET when caching.

settings.name: CACHE_LOCK
settings.description: Lock concurrent requests when populating the cache.

settings.name: CACHE_LOCK_AGE
settings.description: Pass request to upstream if cache is locked for that time (possible cache).

settings.name: CACHE_LOCK_TIMEOUT
settings.description: Pass request to upstream if cache is locked for that time (no cache).

settings.name: CACHE_METHODS
settings.description: Only cache response if corresponding method is present.

settings.name: CACHE_MIN_USES
settings.description: Number of requests before we put the corresponding response in cache.

settings.name: CACHE_REVALIDATE
settings.description: Revalidate expired items using conditional requests to upstream.

settings.name: CACHE_USE_STALE
settings.description: Determines the use of staled cache response (proxy_cache_use_stale directive).

settings.name: CACHE_VALID
settings.description: Defines default caching with optional status code.
